ecs_component_maps.sampler: enumerate capped compact map, exact descriptor key + exact vtable; never execute resolvers

door_raw_fields.source: 0x1f31a90 registers native field index 0; 0x20df1c0 accesses tuple
door_raw_fields.meaning: transition tuple; complete state enum and instance meaning unverified
raw byte; enabled paths do not prove collision readiness
opaque local component-handle candidate; sampler follows no pointer

door_excluded_field.reason: opaque pointer/reference representation and full ABI not closed; no runtime read

door_native_state_route.limitation: Named script routes and native state registration are static evidence; no GameNet transport/authority/current level instance or safe calling ABI established.

health_raw_fields.source: 0x1f168f0 native field index 0; 0x1f16fc0 clamps against it
health_raw_fields.meaning: float cap candidate; runtime value mapping unverified

health_raw_fields.source: 0x1f168f0 native field index 1; change callback uses threshold
health_raw_fields.meaning: float threshold candidate; full meaning unverified
float value candidate; real enemy HP/death unverified
previous value candidate; raw sampling only

health_native_state_route.static_behavior: Set path clamps [0,+0x80], moves old +0x88 into +0x8C, writes +0x88 and marks dirty; callbacks conditionally dispatch events.
health_native_state_route.limitation: A Health/BotHealth component is not proof of an enemy. Spawn, AI, damage authority, death consequences and cross-peer identity are unverified.

gamenet_registry.known: Registry stores/resolves entity handles and invokes native deserialization on completion.
gamenet_registry.unknown: Current chapter, initial snapshot field coverage, physical collision and remote transport payload meaning; no claim that enabling manager solves door/enemy sync.

accepted_record_checks: vtable whitelist + exact engine descriptor key
component owner + nonzero local component handle
runtime_sampler.limitation: Before/after equality rejects observed races but cannot rule out ABA or every interleaving. Even accepted records are raw local observations, never world replication proof.

next_evidence_needed: Live accepted Door/Health/BotHealth records and raw transitions tied to visible game actions
Scene/asset key that maps the same actor across peers and reloads
Door visual and collision readiness correlated to native lifecycle
Game-thread/lifetime/ABI evidence before any native control call
